messages:
alana: Quick sync — we're proposing schema changes for audit events. Plan: add actor_org + actor_roles, remove user_ip (PII), and introduce an explicit event_version. Also need guidance on KMS-encrypted payload shape and migration window. tagging for owners @mike @sofia

mike: +1 on event_version field. Curious: any live customers relying on user_ip?

sofia: I ran a quick query — 2 internal teams reference user_ip in lightweight rerankers and one third-party integration. We should give a deprecation window, not a hard drop.

kevin: For versioning I'd prefer an explicit string field root.event_version = "2" rather than implicit feature flags. Backwards compatibility: runtime accepts v1/v2 and maps missing fields -> null.

lisa: Also propose an optional metadata.removed_fields array that validators can include in validation reports so customers know what's changed.

sec-bot: vuln-triage note: removing user_ip reduces PII surface. No high-severity vulns found in this change set. Ticket created: SEC-458.

alana: KMS question: should encrypted payloads be encoded as base64 and include kms_key_id? e.g. payload: { encrypted: true, kms_key: "projects/.../keys/..", data: "BASE64(...)" }

mike: That shape is fine but add encryption_alg and aad fields so we can rotate algorithms and carry context.

sofia: Migration suggestion: keep plaintext payloads supported during opt-in phase and introduce payload_state: "plaintext" | "encrypted" to avoid silent failures.

kevin: Migration rollout plan proposal (high level):
  1) Announce change + publish schema RFC.
  2) Add v2 support to validators + SDKs (opt-in).
  3) 30-day opt-in period where we accept v1 and v2. Emit telemetry when v1 is used.
  4) After 30 days, flip default to v2 and continue accepting v1 for compatibility for an additional 60 days with warnings.
  5) Final enforcement after 90 days total.

lisa: For customer-facing validation, build an "audit-validate" CLI that checks event files against both schemas and outputs a human-readable report and suggested remediation. Add to support playbook.

alana: Good. Who owns the communications and docs? @mike?

mike: I can take notices + changelog. @sofia and @kevin can own SDK and validator work. I'll coordinate customer outreach with Lisa.

sofia: I'll add a telemetry event name: audit_schema_migration_warning with fields: client_id, event_version_used, warning_code.

kevin: Also note RBAC implication: normalize actor.roles to an array of strings and add actor.source.host for service accounts so policy checks can rely on consistent fields. Update RBAC policy tests accordingly.

deploy-bot: validators:v2 -> staging deploy scheduled 2025-06-15T22:00Z

alana: Let's file the actual tickets now so we have traceability. I'll create RFC ticket and link the others. Suggested tickets: SEC-459 (schema RFC), ENG-9012 (validator impl), DOCS-1124 (customer guide). I'll assign owners after RFC review.

mike: Sounds good, thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Created SEC-459, ENG-9012, DOCS-1124.
